knownBehavior: Eagle exports selected items as a transfer package.
Eagle documents preservation of folder hierarchy and tags.
Eagle does not preserve Tag Groups when the package is imported.
requiredSamples: one item with multiple files and a custom thumbnail

compatibilityAssertions: Do not treat an Eaglepack as a complete Eagle Library.
Do not implement a parser until reproducible samples answer every listed unknown.
Record Eagle version, platform, sample checksum, and redaction steps with each sample.
Keep live or personal Eagle exports out of the repository.
